The '''Magnet''' is a type of [[bait]] that increases the chance of finding [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|treasure chests]] by 15% (30% chance base instead of 15% base). It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] or purchased from [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|1000}} after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|fishing level 9]]. It can also be purchased from the [[Casino]] for {{Price|1000|Qi}}. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (7% chance).<ref name="chestchance" />

It is received as one of the prizes for winning the Ice Fishing Contest at the [[Festival of Ice]] for the first time, and can also be received as a gift from [[Willy]] at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. It may also randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Wednesday|Wednesdays]] for {{Price|200}}, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|15}}.

Magnets cannot be used with the [[Training Rod]] or the [[Bamboo Pole]]. Only the [[Fiberglass Rod]], the [[Iridium Rod]], and the [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] can use bait. Magnets can also technically be used in a [[Crab Pot]], but it is no better than [[Bait (item)|standard bait]] as crab pots never yield any treasure.

The Magnet is not used in any [[quests]].

==Notes==
*Despite the description, the Magnet has the same effect on fish bite rate as standard [[Bait (item)|Bait]] (decreasing biting time by 50%).
*While the Magnet can be purchased at the [[Fish Shop]] for {{Price|1000}}, crafting is a cheaper option, even if purchasing the ingredients.  In year 1, 5 [[Iron Ore]] and 1 [[Coal]] cost {{Price|900}} at the [[Blacksmith]] ({{Price|300}} per magnet).  In years 2+, 5 Iron Ore and 1 Coal cost {{Price|1500}} ({{Price|500}} per magnet).
*Success at playing the minigames in the [[Casino]] can also yield virtually free Magnets from the Casino shop.
